messages:
anna-ops: starting staged rollout for inference-api v2.4.0 -> global 0% -> 20% over 10m. change window: now +10m. release notes: https://redwood.in/releases/2.4.0

dev-deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout initiated service=inference-api image=rwind/inference:2.4.0 strategy=staged target=20% eta=10m

sam-m: quick heads-up — p50 latency for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 jumped +120ms in the last 5m and error rate 0.9% -> 2.7%. not seeing obvious infra spikes elsewhere. tagging @luis

luis: pulling logs now. pod inference-api-eu-3 shows OOMKilled at 12:34:56 and repeated restarts. KV cache evictions increased. suspect runtime kernel change in 2.4.0 affecting memory path.

rachael: can we isolate EU? i'd prefer pin eu-west to previous variant v2.3.1 and let the rest continue to ramp. minimizes blast radius for EU customers.

anna-ops: decision needed — full pause or region pin + continue global ramp. what's the user impact if we pin EU now?

sam-m: impact = ~0.04% of overall active users, but EU accounts for ~65% of those errors. pinning EU to v2.3.1 should drop user-facing errors to baseline quickly. vote: partial pause (EU only).

dev-deploy-bot: executing route change: service=inference-api region=eu-west action=pin variant=v2.3.1 -> in progress

oncall-bot: alert: ksvc inference-api-eu node_restarts=3 last_5m; investigator assigned.

dev-deploy-bot: route change complete: inference-api:eu-west -> variant=v2.3.1 pinned. rollout global remaining regions still at 20%.

luis: confirmed — after pin, eu-west error rate dropped from 2.7% to 0.6% within 2m. warmed additional v2.3.1 nodes to absorb traffic. opening ticket: INC-2026 with logs + diagnostic.

rachael: okay to continue ramp in non-EU regions to 50% but monitor 5m windows for p50 and error_rate. if either crosses threshold (p50 +100ms OR error_rate +1.5%) we revert global ramp. i'll watch metrics and slack.

anna-ops: agreed. action items: luis -> investigate OOM root cause and attach kernel diff; sam -> run perf diff between 2.3.1 and 2.4.0 on kv/cache behavior; rachael -> watch and escalate. resume schedule: ramp to 50% (non-eu) in 20m. :thumbsup:

dev-deploy-bot: update: staged_percent=35% (eu-west pinned to v2.3.1).

anna-ops: updating release notes and changelog with regional pin note and rollback playbook link. will post final when rollout completes or if we need full rollback. thanks everyone.
